quests.name: Cook's Assistant
quests.start: Talk to the Cook in the cookhouse, south-west of the town square.
rewards: Cooked lobster sold at the General Store

bonus.desc: +5% Cooking XP and burn food 5% less often

quests.name: Rest for the Fallen
quests.start: Talk to Father Elric outside the church, north of the town square.
rewards: Unlocks the Protect from Melee prayer (Prayer 43)

bonus.desc: Prayers drain 5% slower and you slowly regain prayer points

quests.name: Doric's Quest
quests.start: Talk to Doric at the smithy, south-east of the town square.
rewards: Mithril and adamant tools sold at the Tool Shop

quests.name: Goblin Trouble
quests.start: Talk to Captain Rhea on the south road out of town.

bonus.desc: +10% damage against goblins and hill giants, +20 max hitpoints

quests.name: Farmer's Hides
quests.start: Talk to Farmer Gil at the cow field gate, north-west of town.
rewards: Oak shortbows sold at the General Store

bonus.desc: +5% Crafting XP and 5% off everything in shops

quests.name: Tools of the Trade
quests.start: Talk to Bob at Bob's Brilliant Tools, north-east of the square.

bonus.desc: +3% success when mining, woodcutting and fishing

quests.name: Supply Run
quests.start: Talk to the Merchant at the General Store stall, east of the square.

bonus.desc: Shops pay you 10% more and +5% Fletching XP

quests.name: Archers in the Woods
quests.start: Talk to Ranger Wyn on the western edge of town.

bonus.desc: +2 ranged max hit and +10% damage against dark archers

quests.name: Knight's Honour
quests.start: Talk to Sir Vyvin on the north road, past the church.

bonus.desc: Take 3% less damage, +30 max hitpoints, +10% damage against black knights

quests.name: Fisherman's Catch
quests.start: Talk to Fisherman Fred by the lake, south-west of town.

quests.name: Ashford's Plea
quests.start: Talk to Mayor Aldric in Ashford, far to the east.

quests.name: Guard Duty
quests.start: Talk to Guard Captain Ryn in Ashford.

quests.name: Herb Gathering
quests.start: Talk to Herbalist Wren near Ashford.

quests.name: Torin's Order
quests.start: Talk to Smith Torin in Ashford Smithy.

quests.name: Eastern Feast
quests.start: Talk to Chef Bran in Ashford.

quests.name: Scout's Report
quests.start: Talk to Scout Vey near Ashford.

quests.name: Kael's Tools
quests.start: Talk to Miner Kael near the eastern mines.

quests.name: Rest for the East
quests.start: Talk to Sister Lira in Ashford.

quests.name: Supply the Store
quests.start: Talk to Trader Mira in Ashford Store.

quests.name: Eastern Honour
quests.start: Talk to Sir Elric near Ashford.

quests.name: Tess's Catch
quests.start: Talk to Angler Tess near Ashford.

quests.name: Olan's Timber
quests.start: Talk to Carpenter Olan in Ashford.

quests.name: Granny's Pie

data.name: Granny's Pie
data.where: by her cottage west of the town square
intro: Oh, hello dearie! My grandchildren are visiting and my old hands can't manage the stove any more.
Could you cook me 3 pieces of meat and 2 shrimps? The range is in the cookhouse.

steps.nag: 3 Cooked meat and 2 Cooked shrimp, dearie. Cows are north-west and shrimp are in the lake.

data.end: Smells just like I used to make! Here, take some of my trout too.
data.thanks: The grandchildren ate every crumb. Bless you, dearie.

quests.start: Talk to Granny Hilda by her cottage west of the town square.

quests.name: Wool for Winter

data.name: Wool for Winter
data.where: by her cottage west of the town square
intro: Winter is coming and the grandchildren need warm clothes.
Mara the Weaver might help. Would you go and ask her for me?

say: Clothes for Hilda's grandchildren? Of course!
But I'm out of fibre. Bring me 10 Flax and I'll weave them something cosy.

steps.reply: Lovely flax! I'll have the clothes woven by tonight. Go and tell Hilda.
steps.nag: 10 Flax, please. It grows in the fields.

data.end: Mara has sent the clothes already! You're a treasure. Have this cowl my late husband wore.
data.thanks: The little ones are warm as toast.

quests.start: Talk to Granny Hilda by her cottage west of the town square.

quests.name: Pip's Pockets

data.name: Pip's Pockets
data.where: east of the town square
intro: Oi, you! Wanna learn a trick? Nobody notices a quick hand in a busy square.
Lift a few purses from the townsfolk, then bring me 2 Cooked shrimp. I'm starvin'.

steps.hint: Pickpocket the Man or Woman in town.

data.end: Ha! You're a natural. Here's a cut of my savings.
data.thanks: Keep your fingers light and your feet quick!

quests.start: Talk to Pip east of the town square.

quests.name: Light Fingers

data.name: Light Fingers
data.where: east of the town square
intro: Word is the sailors in Port Sarim carry foreign coin.
Go west to the docks, ask a sailor about the 'night tide', and practise your craft on the way.

say: The night tide? Hah. Pip sent you, didn't he?
Tell that rascal the ship sails without him. Here, keep your hands off my purse.

data.end: Sailin' without me, is it? Fine. You've earned this ring I, er, found.

quests.start: Talk to Pip east of the town square.

quests.name: Unquiet Graves

data.name: Unquiet Graves
data.where: north-west of the town square
intro: The dead won't stay put! Zombies keep climbing out of the old graveyard north-west of town.
Put 3 of them down and bury 3 bones so their spirits rest.
data.end: Quiet at last. Here, I dug these up. Bury them for the gods' favour.
data.thanks: Not a groan from the graveyard all week.

quests.start: Talk to Osric the Gravedigger north-west of the town square.

quests.name: Rattling Bones

data.name: Rattling Bones
data.where: north-west of the town square
intro: Now it's skeletons! They rattle about north-east of town in the boneyard.
Visit the boneyard, smash 4 skeletons and bury 5 bones.

bonus.desc: +5% damage against skeletons and prayers drain 2% slower

data.end: You've a gravedigger's grit. Take this holy symbol.
data.thanks: The boneyard is silent. Good work.

quests.start: Talk to Osric the Gravedigger north-west of the town square.

bonus.desc: +5% damage against skeletons and prayers drain 2% slower

quests.name: Lamplighter

data.name: Lamplighter
data.where: east of the town square
intro: Brightwater's lamps burn wood all night, and my woodpile is empty.
Bring me 10 Logs and 5 Oak logs?
data.end: Brightwater will shine tonight! Thank you.

quests.start: Talk to Lena the Lamplighter east of the town square.

quests.name: Into the Dark Wood

data.name: Into the Dark Wood
data.where: east of the town square
intro: Something shoots out my western lamps every night. I think it's the dark archers.
Scout the dark wood west of the lake and defeat 3 of them.
data.end: The western lamps stayed lit last night! Take this bow.

quests.start: Talk to Lena the Lamplighter east of the town square.

quests.name: Brewer's Errand

data.name: Brewer's Errand
data.where: west of the town square
intro: My new ale needs a herbal kick! Guam leaf, to be precise.
Bring me 2 clean Guam leaf and 3 Vials of water. Pick herbs in the patches north of the square and fill vials at the well.
data.end: Perfect! My Guam Ale will be famous. Have a couple of my... other brews.
data.thanks: The Guam Ale is selling by the barrel!

quests.start: Talk to Bram the Brewer west of the town square.

quests.name: Bram's Tonic

data.name: Bram's Tonic
data.where: west of the town square
intro: Customers keep falling ill from bad water. I want to sell a tonic.
Brew me 2 Attack potions and 1 Antipoison in the Herblore tab.
data.end: Bottled courage and a cure! You're a fine apothecary.

quests.start: Talk to Bram the Brewer west of the town square.

quests.name: Runic Studies

data.name: Runic Studies
data.where: on the south road near the wizard tower
intro: I'm writing a book on runes, but I've never seen one being made!
Visit the Air altar south-west of town, craft some runes there and bring me 10 Air runes. Rune essence comes from Aubury in Varrock or the essence mine.

steps.hint: Use Craft-rune at an altar with Rune essence.

data.end: Chapter three is finished! Take these mind runes for your trouble.
data.thanks: My book is nearly done, thanks to you.

quests.start: Talk to Tamsin the Scholar on the south road near the wizard tower.

quests.name: The Wizard's Student

data.name: The Wizard's Student
data.where: on the south road near the wizard tower
intro: Wizard Mizgog says he'll review my book if a real spellcaster vouches for it.
Go to the tower, speak to Mizgog, then prove yourself by casting spells in battle.

say: Tamsin's book? Hmph. Show me you can cast, and I'll read it.
Go and earn 1000 Magic experience in battle.

data.end: Mizgog loved it! He sent this staff for you.
data.thanks: My book is on the tower's shelf now!

quests.start: Talk to Tamsin the Scholar on the south road near the wizard tower.

quests.name: An Old Soldier

data.name: An Old Soldier
data.where: south-east of the town square
intro: Back in my day, I'd clear goblins and wolves before breakfast.
Show me you've got the steel: 6 goblins and 2 wolves.
data.end: Ha! You remind me of myself. Here's some coin.

quests.start: Talk to Old Aldo south-east of the town square.

quests.name: Giant Slayer

data.name: Giant Slayer
data.where: south-east of the town square
intro: The hill giants took my knee forty years ago. Time for revenge, by proxy.
Slay 5 hill giants north of town and bring me 3 Big bones as proof.

bonus.desc: +5% damage against hill giants and +10 max hitpoints

data.end: Avenged at last! Take my old maul. It's heavy, mind.

quests.start: Talk to Old Aldo south-east of the town square.

bonus.desc: +5% damage against hill giants and +10 max hitpoints

quests.name: The Black Outpost

data.name: The Black Outpost
data.where: south-east of the town square
intro: The Black Knights have built an outpost north of town. Sir Vyvin's too proud to ask for help.
Scout it, defeat 5 knights and bring a Steel platebody for the town militia.

bonus.desc: Take 1% less damage, +5% damage against black knights

data.end: The militia will wear that with pride. This amulet kept me alive once.

quests.start: Talk to Old Aldo south-east of the town square.

bonus.desc: Take 1% less damage, +5% damage against black knights

quests.name: Spider Silk

data.name: Spider Silk
data.where: north-west of the square
intro: Giant spiders nest north-west of town, and their silk is the finest thread there is.
Clear 4 spiders from the nest and bring me 3 Soft leather to line the cloth.
data.end: Silk and leather! I'll make the finest cloaks in the land.
data.thanks: My cloaks sell all the way to Varrock.

quests.start: Talk to Mara the Weaver north-west of the square.

quests.name: Rooftop Runner

data.name: Rooftop Runner
data.where: at the agility course south-east of town
intro: Legs like jelly? Let's fix that.
Run my course past the mine and earn 400 Agility XP.

steps.hint: Cross the obstacles on the course.

data.end: Now you're moving! Have some energy potions.

quests.start: Talk to Coach Dell at the agility course south-east of town.

quests.name: Over the Wall

data.name: Over the Wall
data.where: at the agility course south-east of town
intro: My old rival runs the course in Varrock. Go see it, and train until you're better than his students.
Visit the Varrock course and earn 2500 Agility XP anywhere.
data.end: Better than his whole class! Ha! Take these.

quests.start: Talk to Coach Dell at the agility course south-east of town.

quests.name: The Hermit's Hound

data.name: The Hermit's Hound
data.where: in the wilds north-west of Brightwater
intro: Wolves killed my dog. Now they circle my hut every night.
Kill 5 wolves, then bring me 5 Raw beef so I can lure a new pup.
data.end: A pup came sniffing for the beef already! Thank you, friend.

quests.start: Talk to Hermit Grell in the wilds north-west of Brightwater.

quests.name: Grell's Ward

data.name: Grell's Ward
data.where: in the wilds north-west of Brightwater
intro: The dead walk near my hut too. I need a holy ward.
Pray at the Body altar to the north-west, put down 5 zombies, then bury 10 bones to bless the ground.
data.end: I can feel the ward holding. Take these potions.
data.thanks: Biscuit and I sleep soundly now.

quests.start: Talk to Hermit Grell in the wilds north-west of Brightwater.

quests.name: Pirate's Grog

data.name: Pirate's Grog
data.where: on the Port Sarim docks
intro: Arr! Me crew be hungry and the ship's cook ran off with a mermaid.
Fetch me 3 Cooked trout and 5 Cooked shrimp and I'll pay ye in honest pirate gold.
data.end: Har har! A feast fit for buccaneers.
data.thanks: The crew sings yer name, matey.

quests.start: Talk to Captain Redbeard on the Port Sarim docks.

quests.name: Treasure of the Tides

data.name: Treasure of the Tides
data.where: on the Port Sarim docks
intro: Some scallywag lifted me treasure map! I reckon it were one of them sailors.
Ask the sailors, lift a few purses to find it, then dig where it says: the willows west o' town. Bring willow logs so I know ye were there.

say: A map? Aye, I nicked it. Don't tell Redbeard!
I sold it on, but I remember: the X is under the willows west of town.

steps.hint: Pickpocket sailors and townsfolk for clues.

data.end: Me treasure! And ye didn't even keep it. Take me old cutlass, ye've earned it.

quests.start: Talk to Captain Redbeard on the Port Sarim docks.

quests.name: Press Gang

data.name: Press Gang
data.where: on the Port Sarim docks
intro: Bandits south-east o' town keep raidin' me supply wagons.
Sink 6 o' them and bring me 2 Steel swords to arm me new crew.

bonus.desc: +5% damage against bandits and +5 max hitpoints

data.end: That'll teach 'em! Me crew is armed and ready.

quests.start: Talk to Captain Redbeard on the Port Sarim docks.

bonus.desc: +5% damage against bandits and +5 max hitpoints

quests.name: Grocer's Stock

data.name: Grocer's Stock
data.where: at his stall in Port Sarim
intro: The ships want fresh food and my shelves are empty!
Bring me 10 Raw shrimp and 5 Raw beef.
data.end: Fresh as the sea breeze. Thank you!

quests.start: Talk to Wydin the Grocer at his stall in Port Sarim.

quests.name: Exotic Spices

data.name: Exotic Spices
data.where: at his stall in Port Sarim
intro: Sailors want spiced food. The best spices are herbs, if you know how to clean them.
Bring me 3 clean Marrentill and 2 clean Tarromin.
data.end: What an aroma! Take these potions, they're good for long voyages.
data.thanks: My spiced fish is famous now.

quests.start: Talk to Wydin the Grocer at his stall in Port Sarim.

quests.name: Mending Nets

data.name: Mending Nets
data.where: by the nets on the Port Sarim waterfront
intro: A shark tore through my nets. I need flax to mend them.
Bring me 15 Flax, then go and catch a few fish to test them.
data.end: Good as new, and you've the hands of a fisher. Off with you!

quests.start: Talk to Net-mender Gerda by the nets on the Port Sarim waterfront.

quests.name: Deep Water

data.name: Deep Water
data.where: by the nets on the Port Sarim waterfront
intro: The harbour wants lobster and salmon, and I'm too old for the cages.
Bring me 5 Raw lobster and 5 Raw salmon.
data.end: Beauties! This ring was my mother's. It'll bring you luck.

quests.start: Talk to Net-mender Gerda by the nets on the Port Sarim waterfront.

quests.name: The Big One

data.name: The Big One
data.where: by the nets on the Port Sarim waterfront
intro: Forty years I've hunted the shark that tore my nets.
Harpoon 5 Raw shark for me, then cook 5 more so the whole port can feast.

bonus.desc: +3% Fishing XP and burn food 3% less often

data.end: At last! The port will talk of this for years. Take some shark for the road.

quests.start: Talk to Net-mender Gerda by the nets on the Port Sarim waterfront.

bonus.desc: +3% Fishing XP and burn food 3% less often

quests.name: Lost Cargo

data.name: Lost Cargo
data.where: at the Port Sarim harbour office
intro: A crate of goods went missing between the docks and Gerrant's shop.
Check the docks, ask Shopkeeper Gerrant, and replace the cargo: 5 Logs and 3 Iron ore.

steps.where: in his shop in Port Sarim
say: Brice's crate? It fell off the dock, I saw it sink!
Logs and iron ore, it was. Replace it and he'll never know.

data.end: All present and correct. The paperwork is happy.

quests.start: Talk to Harbourmaster Brice at the Port Sarim harbour office.

quests.name: Learning the Ropes

data.name: Learning the Ropes
data.where: at the Port Sarim harbour office
intro: My dock hands need someone to show them the rigging.
Visit the rigging course east of the docks and earn 2000 Agility XP.
data.end: The lads say you climb like a cat. Good work.

quests.start: Talk to Harbourmaster Brice at the Port Sarim harbour office.

quests.name: Customs and Excise

data.name: Customs and Excise
data.where: at the Port Sarim harbour office
intro: Someone is smuggling chaos runes through my harbour.
Lift a few purses for evidence, ask Betty what she knows, then find where the runes are made.

steps.where: in her magic shop in Port Sarim
say: Chaos runes? Not from my shop, dear.
They're made at the dark altar south-east of town, past the bandits. Be careful.

bonus.desc: +2% Thieving XP and shops pay you 2% more

data.end: The Chaos altar! I'll post guards. Keep these confiscated runes.

quests.start: Talk to Harbourmaster Brice at the Port Sarim harbour office.

bonus.desc: +2% Thieving XP and shops pay you 2% more

quests.name: Thurgo's Lunch

data.name: Thurgo's Lunch
data.where: on the west side of Port Sarim
intro: Hungry. So hungry. Dwarves can't smith on an empty belly.
Bring me 5 Cooked meat and I'll give you some iron.
data.end: Mmm! Here, iron bars. Fair trade.

quests.start: Talk to Thurgo on the west side of Port Sarim.

quests.name: Imcando Steel

data.name: Imcando Steel
data.where: on the west side of Port Sarim
intro: I'll teach you old dwarf tricks, but first, steel and coal.
Bring me 5 Steel bars and 5 Coal, then go practise at any anvil.
data.end: Not bad for a non-dwarf! Have some mithril.
data.thanks: You hammer like a dwarf now.

quests.start: Talk to Thurgo on the west side of Port Sarim.

quests.name: A Runite Blade

data.name: A Runite Blade
data.where: on the west side of Port Sarim
intro: Before I die I want to forge one perfect runite blade.
Bring me 4 Runite ore and 3 Rune bars.

bonus.desc: +3% Smithing XP and +1% success when gathering

data.end: Perfect. Take the first one. I'll make another for me.
data.thanks: My finest work, in your hands.

quests.start: Talk to Thurgo on the west side of Port Sarim.

bonus.desc: +3% Smithing XP and +1% success when gathering

quests.name: Water for Mabel

data.name: Water for Mabel
data.where: on the east side of Port Sarim
intro: My garden is dry, and I don't trust well water. Only water runes will do!
Go to the Water altar south-west of town and craft me 15 Water runes.

steps.hint: Craft runes at the Water altar (needs Runecrafting 5).

data.end: Lovely! My roses will bloom like never before.
data.thanks: Come and see my roses some time.

quests.start: Talk to Old Mabel on the east side of Port Sarim.

quests.name: Cabin Boy Blues

data.name: Cabin Boy Blues
data.where: in Port Sarim square
intro: I overslept and Captain Redbeard's ship left without me. Then it came back, and now I'm too scared to face him!
Could you speak to him for me? And maybe bring me a Bronze sword so I look brave.

say: Kennith? Har! Tell the lad all is forgiven.
But he swabs the deck for a month.

data.end: Forgiven! And a sword! I'll be a pirate yet!
data.thanks: Swabbing the deck isn't so bad.

quests.start: Talk to Kennith in Port Sarim square.

quests.name: Witch's Brew

data.name: Witch's Brew
data.where: at the west edge of Port Sarim
intro: My brew needs moss from a living giant. Giants don't like that.
Visit the Moss Giant woods west of town, defeat 3, and bring me 2 Strength potions to steady my hand.
data.end: Bubble, bubble! The brew is perfect. Wear this hat, it suits you.

quests.start: Talk to Velma the Witch at the west edge of Port Sarim.

quests.name: Frozen Heart

data.name: Frozen Heart
data.where: at the west edge of Port Sarim
intro: The ice giants to the south-west have a frozen heart of magic.
Go to the frozen hollow, defeat 3 ice giants and earn 3000 Magic XP to bind the cold.

bonus.desc: +5% damage against ice giants and +2% Magic XP

data.end: I can feel the cold in you. Take this staff, it never runs dry.

quests.start: Talk to Velma the Witch at the west edge of Port Sarim.

bonus.desc: +5% damage against ice giants and +2% Magic XP

quests.name: Mossy Menace

data.name: Mossy Menace
data.where: in the woods west of Port Sarim
intro: Moss giants are trampling my woods.
Defeat 4 of them and bury 4 of their bones to keep the forest spirits happy.
data.end: The woods breathe easier. Thank you.

quests.start: Talk to Ranger Sorrel in the woods west of Port Sarim.

quests.name: Highway Robbery

data.name: Highway Robbery
data.where: in the woods west of Port Sarim
intro: Bandits ambush travellers on the south road and worship at that dark altar.
Shoot down 8 bandits, then scout the Chaos altar.

bonus.desc: +1 ranged max hit and +3% damage against bandits

data.end: The road is safe. Take my spare bow.

quests.start: Talk to Ranger Sorrel in the woods west of Port Sarim.

bonus.desc: +1 ranged max hit and +3% damage against bandits

quests.name: The Lost Tome

data.name: The Lost Tome
data.where: in Varrock, west of the square
intro: A book on the Earth altar has gone missing from my library. Aubury borrowed it, I think.
Ask Aubury, check the altar north-west of the palace, and bring me 20 Feathers so I can make quills to rewrite it.

steps.where: in his rune shop in Varrock
say: Reldo's book? I'm afraid I spilled tea on it.
Everything it said is carved on the Earth altar anyway. Go and look.

data.end: I'll have it rewritten by Saturday. Thank you!
data.thanks: The tome is back on the shelf.

quests.start: Talk to Reldo the Librarian in Varrock, west of the square.

quests.name: Varrock's History

data.name: Varrock's History
data.where: in Varrock, west of the square
intro: Varrock was built near two great altars and a mine of pure magic.
Visit the essence mine and the Fire altar, then ask the Hero in Falador what he knows of the dragons.

say: Reldo wants dragon lore? Tell him the green dragons came after the altars were built.
Their lair is far north of Varrock. Only a fool goes there unprepared.

data.end: Fascinating! Another chapter for my history.

quests.start: Talk to Reldo the Librarian in Varrock, west of the square.

quests.name: Demon Lore

data.name: Demon Lore
data.where: in Varrock, west of the square
intro: Lesser demons have taken the ruins north of the city. My books say magic hurts them most.
Go to the ruins, banish 3 demons and earn 4000 Magic XP.
data.end: Banished! Take this hat, it belonged to a wizard who wasn't so lucky.

quests.start: Talk to Reldo the Librarian in Varrock, west of the square.

quests.name: Romeo's Letter

data.name: Romeo's Letter
data.where: in Varrock square
intro: I wish to ask Juliet to a picnic, but I'm too shy! Gertrude knows her.
Please ask Gertrude to pass on my letter, then bring me 2 Cooked salmon for the picnic.

say: A letter for Juliet? How sweet! I'll pass it on.
Tell Romeo she said yes. She always says yes.

data.end: She said yes! Oh, joyous day!

quests.start: Talk to Romeo in Varrock square.

quests.name: A Duel of Hearts

data.name: A Duel of Hearts
data.where: in Varrock square
intro: A Black Knight insulted Juliet! I challenged him, but... I can't fight.
Defeat 2 Black Knights north of Brightwater in my name, and bring me an Iron platebody so I look the part.
data.end: Juliet thinks I'm a hero! Our secret, yes?

quests.start: Talk to Romeo in Varrock square.

quests.name: Fur Trade

data.name: Fur Trade
data.where: on the east side of Varrock
intro: Furs are scarce this season. Cowhide will have to do.
Bring me 10 Cowhide and I'll pay a fair price.
data.end: A fair trade. Come back if you find more.

quests.start: Talk to Baraek on the east side of Varrock.

quests.name: Hard Bargain

data.name: Hard Bargain
data.where: on the east side of Varrock
intro: The guards want armour, not furs. Hard leather!
Bring me 5 Hard leather and a Hard leather body.
data.end: Fine work. I'll give you a discount from now on.

quests.start: Talk to Baraek on the east side of Varrock.

quests.name: Staff Shortage

data.name: Staff Shortage
data.where: on the west side of Varrock
intro: I'm out of wood for staves! Oak is best.
Bring me 10 Oak logs, then try a few spells so I know you can use a staff.
data.end: A natural! Have one of my plain staves.

quests.start: Talk to Zaff on the west side of Varrock.

quests.name: Elemental Staves

data.name: Elemental Staves
data.where: on the west side of Varrock
intro: To make elemental staves I need elemental runes.
Visit the Fire altar and bring me 50 Fire runes and 50 Earth runes.
data.end: Perfect! Your very own staff of fire.
data.thanks: My elemental staves are the talk of the city.

quests.start: Talk to Zaff on the west side of Varrock.

quests.name: Mystic Arts

data.name: Mystic Arts
data.where: on the west side of Varrock
intro: A mystic staff needs the power of death itself.
Go to the Death altar deep in the wilds, earn 5000 Runecrafting XP and bring me 100 Death runes.
data.end: The finest staff I have ever made. It is yours.

quests.start: Talk to Zaff on the west side of Varrock.

quests.name: Spare Change

data.name: Spare Change
data.where: in the north of Varrock
intro: Spare a coin? No? Then let me teach you how to find some.
Lift a few purses, then bring me 3 Cooked meat. I'm famished.
data.end: You're a good sort. Here's what I've saved.

quests.start: Talk to Charlie the Tramp in the north of Varrock.

quests.name: The Phoenix Gang

data.name: The Phoenix Gang
data.where: in the north of Varrock
intro: The Phoenix Gang wants a new member. Want in?
Distract a Varrock Guard with a chat, prove your skill, then meet the gang in the maples south-west of town.

say: Hm? Directions? The palace is that way, citizen.
Wait, where did my lunch go?

data.end: Welcome to the gang! Here's your cut.

quests.start: Talk to Charlie the Tramp in the north of Varrock.

quests.name: Palace Guard

data.name: Palace Guard
data.where: at the south gate of Varrock
intro: The palace guard is short of armour.
Smith me 2 Iron full helms and 2 Iron shields, then train your Defence.
data.end: You'd make a fine guard. Thank you.

quests.start: Talk to Captain Rovin at the south gate of Varrock.

quests.name: Dragon Watch

data.name: Dragon Watch
data.where: at the south gate of Varrock
intro: Green dragons have been seen flying toward the city.
Go to their lair, slay 4 and bring back 4 Dragon bones as proof.

bonus.desc: +5% damage against green dragons, take 1% less damage and +10 max hitpoints

data.end: Varrock owes you its life. Take this wyrmscale shield.
data.thanks: Not a dragon in the sky.

quests.start: Talk to Captain Rovin at the south gate of Varrock.

bonus.desc: +5% damage against green dragons, take 1% less damage and +10 max hitpoints

quests.name: Gertrude's Cat

data.name: Gertrude's Cat
data.where: in the north-west of Varrock
intro: My kitten Fluffs has run off again!
She loves the maple trees south-west of town. Look there and bring 5 Raw shrimp to lure her home.
data.end: Fluffs! She came running for the shrimp. Thank you!

quests.start: Talk to Gertrude in the north-west of Varrock.

quests.name: Tanner's Apprentice

data.name: Tanner's Apprentice
data.where: in the south-east of Varrock
intro: My apprentice quit. Want to learn the trade?
Bring me 8 Cowhide, then tan and craft some leather of your own.

steps.hint: Craft anything in the Crafting tab.

data.end: You've got the knack. Take some leather.

quests.start: Talk to Ellis the Tanner in the south-east of Varrock.

quests.name: Varrock Remedies

data.name: Varrock Remedies
data.where: in the north-west of Varrock
intro: The palace wants a stock of potions.
Brew me 2 Defence potions and 2 Strength potions.
data.end: Excellent brewing! Have one of my super restores.

quests.start: Talk to Apothecary Vorn in the north-west of Varrock.

quests.name: Frostbite Cure

data.name: Frostbite Cure
data.where: in the north-west of Varrock
intro: Frostbite is spreading from the icy ridge east of town.
Defeat 4 ice giants there, then bring me 2 Super attacks and 2 Prayer potions for the sick.

bonus.desc: +2% Herblore XP and +3% damage against ice giants

data.end: The cure works! Varrock is warm again.
data.thanks: Not a case of frostbite since.

quests.start: Talk to Apothecary Vorn in the north-west of Varrock.

bonus.desc: +2% Herblore XP and +3% damage against ice giants

quests.name: Slayer's Challenge

data.name: Slayer's Challenge
data.where: on the road north of Varrock
intro: So you want to be a slayer? Prove it.
Kill 4 lesser demons in the ruins and 3 ice giants on the ridge.

bonus.desc: +3% damage against lesser demons and +5 max hitpoints

data.end: Not bad. Not bad at all.

quests.start: Talk to Slayer Master Vannaka on the road north of Varrock.

bonus.desc: +3% damage against lesser demons and +5 max hitpoints

quests.name: Scorchwing

data.name: Scorchwing
data.where: on the road north of Varrock
intro: There is one beast I never managed to kill: Scorchwing.
Find its nest at the edge of the world, slay it, and bring me 3 Dragon bones.

bonus.desc: +5% damage against Scorchwing, take 1% less damage and +10 max hitpoints

data.end: You did it. You actually did it. Take my cape. You've earned it more than I have.

quests.start: Talk to Slayer Master Vannaka on the road north of Varrock.

bonus.desc: +5% damage against Scorchwing, take 1% less damage and +10 max hitpoints

quests.name: The Knight's Sword

data.name: The Knight's Sword
data.where: by the castle in Falador
intro: I lost Sir Vyvin's sword! He'll have my head!
Reldo in Varrock may know how it was made. Ask him, then bring me 3 Steel bars and an Iron sword so I can have a copy forged.

say: Sir Vyvin's sword? A simple steel blade with an iron core.
Any good smith could copy it with steel bars and an iron sword.

data.end: Saved! Sir Vyvin will never know.
data.thanks: Shh! Not a word to Sir Vyvin.

quests.start: Talk to The Squire by the castle in Falador.

quests.name: Squire's Honour

data.name: Squire's Honour
data.where: by the castle in Falador
intro: I want to become a knight, but I need someone to show me how it's done.
Defeat 6 Black Knights and bring me a Mithril full helm to wear at my knighting.
data.end: Sir Amik says I'm ready! Thank you!

quests.start: Talk to The Squire by the castle in Falador.

quests.name: Black Knights' Fortress

data.name: Black Knights' Fortress
data.where: in the White Knights’ castle, south of Falador square
intro: The Black Knights plan an attack on Falador. I need a spy.
Sharpen your stealth, scout their outpost north of Brightwater, and thin their ranks by 4. Then report to my squire.

say: You're back! What did you see?
I'll write it all down for Sir Amik. Go and tell him yourself!

bonus.desc: +3% damage against black knights and +5 max hitpoints

data.end: Their plans are ruined. Falador thanks you.

quests.start: Talk to Sir Amik Varze in the White Knights’ castle, south of Falador square.

bonus.desc: +3% damage against black knights and +5 max hitpoints

quests.name: The Holy Grail

data.name: The Holy Grail
data.where: in the White Knights’ castle, south of Falador square
intro: Legends tell of a holy grail guarded by the ogre warlord Grumsh.
Seek Sister Sabreen's blessing, pray at the Mind altar, bury 20 bones, and defeat Grumsh.

say: The Grail quest? May Saradomin guide you.
Bless your path at the Mind altar and honour the dead.

bonus.desc: Prayers drain 3% slower and +10 max hitpoints

data.end: The Grail! You are the greatest knight Falador has known.
data.thanks: Your name is carved in the castle hall.

quests.start: Talk to Sir Amik Varze in the White Knights’ castle, south of Falador square.

bonus.desc: Prayers drain 3% slower and +10 max hitpoints

quests.name: Healing Hands

data.name: Healing Hands
data.where: in the south-east of Falador
intro: The sick need food, and the dead need rest.
Bring me 5 Cooked trout and bury 3 bones.
data.end: Bless you, child.

quests.start: Talk to Sister Sabreen in the south-east of Falador.

quests.name: Saradomin's Relic

data.name: Saradomin's Relic
data.where: in the south-east of Falador
intro: A relic was lost near the Body altar, and zombies guard it now.
Go to the altar, put down 4 zombies and bring me 5 Big bones to bless the relic.
data.end: The relic is safe. Saradomin smiles on you.
data.thanks: The relic glows on the altar.

quests.start: Talk to Sister Sabreen in the south-east of Falador.

quests.name: Boot's Lost Pick

data.name: Boot's Lost Pick
data.where: in the north-west of Falador
intro: I left my pick in the Brightwater mine and now someone's using it!
Go and look, and bring me 5 Iron ore and 5 Coal while you're there.
data.end: Ore! Who needs a pick anyway?

quests.start: Talk to Boot the Dwarf in the north-west of Falador.

quests.name: Deep Delving

data.name: Deep Delving
data.where: in the north-west of Falador
intro: Dwarves measure a miner by the hardest ore they can dig.
Bring me 10 Mithril ore and 5 Adamantite ore.

bonus.desc: +1% success when gathering and +2% Mining XP

data.end: A true miner! Take my ring.

quests.start: Talk to Boot the Dwarf in the north-west of Falador.

bonus.desc: +1% success when gathering and +2% Mining XP

quests.name: Sarah's Harvest

data.name: Sarah's Harvest
data.where: in the north-east of Falador
intro: The harvest is late and my hands are full.
Bring me 10 Flax and 3 Grimy guam leaf from the herb patches.
data.end: The harvest is in! Thank you.

quests.start: Talk to Farmer Sarah in the north-east of Falador.

quests.name: Wolves at the Gate

data.name: Wolves at the Gate
data.where: in the north-east of Falador
intro: Wolves come down from the hills between here and Brightwater and kill my cows.
Kill 6 wolves, and bring me 5 Cowhide to replace my losses.
data.end: No howling last night! Thank you.

quests.start: Talk to Farmer Sarah in the north-east of Falador.

quests.name: Wayne's Rush Order

data.name: Wayne's Rush Order
data.where: on the west side of Falador
intro: The White Knights want new armour by Friday!
Smith me 2 Steel platelegs and 2 Steel full helms.
data.end: Just in time! Here's your pay.

quests.start: Talk to Wayne the Armourer on the west side of Falador.

quests.name: Adamant Order

data.name: Adamant Order
data.where: on the west side of Falador
intro: Sir Amik wants adamant. I can't work it. Can you?
Bring me an Adamant platebody and Adamant platelegs.

bonus.desc: +2% Smithing XP and shops pay you 1% more

data.end: Magnificent. You're a better smith than me.

quests.start: Talk to Wayne the Armourer on the west side of Falador.

bonus.desc: +2% Smithing XP and shops pay you 1% more

quests.name: Party Pete's Bash

data.name: Party Pete's Bash
data.where: north of Falador square
intro: It's party time! But there's no food and no decorations!
Bring me 5 Cooked meat and 30 Feathers for the hats.
data.end: Let's party! Woo!

quests.start: Talk to Party Pete north of Falador square.

quests.name: Dance Off

data.name: Dance Off
data.where: north of Falador square
intro: The dance-off is coming and I need a champion with fast feet.
Train on the Falador course north-west of town until you earn 3000 Agility XP.
data.end: You won! The crowd went wild!

quests.start: Talk to Party Pete north of Falador square.

quests.name: Last Orders

data.name: Last Orders
data.where: at the Rising Sun inn in Falador
intro: Everyone wants Bram's Guam Ale from Brightwater, and I don't know the recipe.
Ask Bram the Brewer in Brightwater, then bring me 2 clean Harralander for my own twist.

say: Kaylee wants my recipe? Ha! Guam leaf and a wink.
Tell her Harralander works too, if she's brave.

data.end: Harralander Ale! The regulars will love it.

quests.start: Talk to Kaylee the Barmaid at the Rising Sun inn in Falador.

quests.name: The Bowyer's Apprentice

data.name: The Bowyer's Apprentice
data.where: in the south-west of Falador
intro: I need an apprentice who can string a bow.
Bring me 3 Willow shortbows and 10 Bowstrings.
data.end: Fine work. You're hired!

quests.start: Talk to Elwyn the Bowyer in the south-west of Falador.

quests.name: Yew Bows

data.name: Yew Bows
data.where: in the south-west of Falador
intro: The yews east of Falador make the best bows.
Visit the yew trees and bring me 10 Yew logs and 2 Yew shortbows.

bonus.desc: +1 ranged max hit and +2% Fletching XP

data.end: Beautiful bows. Take these rune arrows.

quests.start: Talk to Elwyn the Bowyer in the south-west of Falador.

bonus.desc: +1 ranged max hit and +2% Fletching XP

quests.name: Magic in the Wood

data.name: Magic in the Wood
data.where: in the south-west of Falador
intro: Only one bow is better than yew: magic.
Visit the magic trees north of Varrock and bring me 10 Magic logs and a Magic shortbow.

bonus.desc: +2 ranged max hit and +1% success when gathering

data.end: A masterpiece. Take my dark bow; you've surpassed me.

quests.start: Talk to Elwyn the Bowyer in the south-west of Falador.

bonus.desc: +2 ranged max hit and +1% success when gathering

quests.name: Ogre Trouble

data.name: Ogre Trouble
data.where: in the wilds north-west of Falador
intro: I was banished from Falador, but I still protect it.
The ogres in the hills grow bold. Go there, kill 5 and bury 5 of their bones.
data.end: Good. Falador sleeps safer, though it doesn't know why.

quests.start: Talk to Oswin the Exile in the wilds north-west of Falador.

quests.name: The Ogre Warlord

data.name: The Ogre Warlord
data.where: in the wilds north-west of Falador
intro: Grumsh, the ogre warlord, is the reason I was exiled. I failed to kill him.
Find his camp, defeat him, then visit the Blood altar beyond it to cleanse yourself.

bonus.desc: +5% damage against Grumsh, +3% against ogres and +10 max hitpoints

data.end: Grumsh is dead. Maybe now I can go home. Take my hammer.

quests.start: Talk to Oswin the Exile in the wilds north-west of Falador.

bonus.desc: +5% damage against Grumsh, +3% against ogres and +10 max hitpoints

quests.name: Ashford Stew

data.name: Ashford Stew
data.where: at the Ashford inn
intro: The inn's famous stew needs beef, and my fire needs wood.
Bring me 3 Raw beef and 5 Logs.
data.end: The stew is bubbling! Have a bowl on me.
data.thanks: The stew is the best in years.

quests.start: Talk to Innkeeper Hazel at the Ashford inn.

quests.name: Full House

data.name: Full House
data.where: at the Ashford inn
intro: A caravan arrived and every room is full!
Bring me 5 Cooked salmon and 5 Cooked trout.
data.end: Every guest is fed and happy!
data.thanks: The caravan left a glowing review.

quests.start: Talk to Innkeeper Hazel at the Ashford inn.

quests.name: Toy Soldiers

data.name: Toy Soldiers
data.where: in Ashford, north of the square
intro: The children want toy soldiers for the harvest fair.
Bring me 5 Logs to carve and 2 Bronze bars for the little swords.
data.end: The children will love these!

quests.start: Talk to Tomas the Toymaker in Ashford, north of the square.

quests.name: Kites and Bows

data.name: Kites and Bows
data.where: in Ashford, north of the square
intro: Now the older children want real bows!
Fletch me 2 Shortbows and an Oak shortbow, and bring 10 Feathers for kites.
data.end: Perfect! I'll teach them to aim at targets, not each other.
data.thanks: Ashford has a junior archery club now.

quests.start: Talk to Tomas the Toymaker in Ashford, north of the square.

quests.name: The Seer's Vision

data.name: The Seer's Vision
data.where: in the north of Ashford
intro: I see... trees that shimmer, and still water.
Go to the magic tree grove north of Brightwater, then to the lake, and tell me what you saw.
data.end: Just as I foresaw. Your future is bright.
data.thanks: I see great things for you.

quests.start: Talk to Iris the Seer in the north of Ashford.

quests.name: Dark Omens

data.name: Dark Omens
data.where: in the north of Ashford
intro: My visions show bones rising in the boneyard west of here.
Go there, destroy 5 skeletons and earn 1500 Magic XP.
data.end: The omen has passed. Thank you.

quests.start: Talk to Iris the Seer in the north of Ashford.

quests.name: Mind over Matter

data.name: Mind over Matter
data.where: in the north of Ashford
intro: To see further I need the power of the mind, and of chaos.
Visit the Mind altar, then bring me 200 Mind runes and 50 Chaos runes.
data.end: I can see the whole realm! Thank you.
data.thanks: I see you coming before you arrive.

quests.start: Talk to Iris the Seer in the north of Ashford.

quests.name: Unpaid Debts

data.name: Unpaid Debts
data.where: on the east side of Ashford
intro: Trader Mira owes me money, and she's dodging me.
Remind her of her debt, then bring me 2 Iron bars she promised as payment.

say: Bertram sent you? Ugh. Fine.
Tell him I'll pay in iron. I don't have any, so you'll have to bring some.

data.end: Debt settled. Here's your commission.

quests.start: Talk to Bertram on the east side of Ashford.

quests.name: The Vault Job

data.name: The Vault Job
data.where: on the east side of Ashford
intro: Someone keeps breaking into my vault. I want to know how.
Practise the thief's arts and climb like one, then ask Sergeant Gruff to set a guard.

say: Bertram's vault? I'll post my best guard.
Tell him not to worry.

data.end: Now I know their tricks. My vault is safe!

quests.start: Talk to Bertram on the east side of Ashford.

quests.name: Fen's Arrows

data.name: Fen's Arrows
data.where: on the west side of Ashford
intro: The militia is out of arrows.
Bring me 50 Bronze arrows and 20 Feathers.
data.end: The militia thanks you!

quests.start: Talk to Fen the Fletcher on the west side of Ashford.

quests.name: The Great Hunt

data.name: The Great Hunt
data.where: on the west side of Ashford
intro: The wolf pack west of here is getting too big.
Go to the den, shoot 8 wolves, and bring me 50 Iron arrows to restock.
data.end: A fine hunt! You're a real ranger.

quests.start: Talk to Fen the Fletcher on the west side of Ashford.

quests.name: Midwife's Herbs

data.name: Midwife's Herbs
data.where: in the south of Ashford
intro: Babies come at all hours, and I'm out of herbs!
Bring me 3 clean Guam leaf and 2 clean Marrentill, and learn to brew a little.
data.end: Bless you. Three babies were born last night!

quests.start: Talk to Magda the Midwife in the south of Ashford.

quests.name: The Fever

data.name: The Fever
data.where: in the south of Ashford
intro: A fever is spreading through Ashford.
Brew me 3 Antipoison and 1 Strength potion.
data.end: The fever is breaking! You've saved lives.

quests.start: Talk to Magda the Midwife in the south of Ashford.

quests.name: Basic Training

data.name: Basic Training
data.where: on the south-east edge of Ashford
intro: Recruit! Drop and give me twenty! Then go and fight something.
Kill 5 goblins and train your Defence.
data.end: Not bad, recruit. Not bad.

quests.start: Talk to Sergeant Gruff on the south-east edge of Ashford.

quests.name: Night Patrol

data.name: Night Patrol
data.where: on the south-east edge of Ashford
intro: Time for a real patrol.
Check the wolf den and the boneyard, and put down 3 wolves and 3 skeletons.
data.end: Patrol complete. You'd make a fine sergeant.

quests.start: Talk to Sergeant Gruff on the south-east edge of Ashford.

quests.name: A Thief's Lesson

data.name: A Thief's Lesson
data.where: in the shadows west of Ashford
intro: Psst. I hear you've got light fingers. Prove it.
Earn 2000 Thieving XP, then tell Pip in Brightwater that Nim says hello.

say: Nim? That old shadow? Tell 'em I said hello back.
And that I still have their lucky coin.

data.end: Pip still has my coin? Ha! Here, your cut.

quests.start: Talk to Nim in the shadows west of Ashford.

quests.name: Special Delivery

data.name: Special Delivery
data.where: at the north edge of Ashford
intro: I've got three letters and only two legs!
Deliver one to Granny Hilda in Brightwater, one to Shopkeeper Gerrant in Port Sarim and one to Aubury in Varrock.

say: A letter from my sister! How lovely, thank you dear.
An order form! Excellent, thank you.
Ah, my essence delivery note. Much obliged.

data.end: All three delivered? You're faster than me!
data.thanks: Want a job as a courier?

quests.start: Talk to Otto the Courier at the north edge of Ashford.

quests.name: Express Post

data.name: Express Post
data.where: at the north edge of Ashford
intro: Express parcels! Cassie in Falador and Horvik in Varrock, as fast as you can.
And keep your legs in shape: earn 2000 Agility XP.

steps.where: at her armour shop in Falador
say: My new shield straps! Thank you.

steps.where: at his weapon shop in Varrock
say: Whetstones, finally. Cheers.

data.end: Record time! You're the best courier in the realm.

quests.start: Talk to Otto the Courier at the north edge of Ashford.

quests.name: Mapping the Realm

data.name: Mapping the Realm
data.where: on the road between Ashford and Varrock
intro: I'm drawing a map of the whole realm, but my feet are tired.
Visit every town square for me: Brightwater, Port Sarim, Varrock, Falador and Ashford.
data.end: My map is complete! Thank you, traveller.
data.thanks: Your name is on my map.

quests.start: Talk to Ada the Cartographer on the road between Ashford and Varrock.

quests.name: Rune Pilgrim

data.name: Rune Pilgrim
data.where: on the road between Ashford and Varrock
intro: The last blank spots on my map are the rune altars.
Visit all nine: Air, Mind, Water, Earth, Fire, Body, Chaos, Death and Blood.

bonus.desc: +3% Runecrafting XP and +1% XP in every skill

data.end: Every altar mapped! You truly are a pilgrim of the runes.
data.thanks: The map is finished, thanks to you.

quests.start: Talk to Ada the Cartographer on the road between Ashford and Varrock.

bonus.desc: +3% Runecrafting XP and +1% XP in every skill

kenn.name: Kennith

velma.name: Velma the Witch
velma.examine: She smells of herbs and something stranger.

reldo.name: Reldo the Librarian

baraek.name: Baraek
baraek.examine: A fur trader with a keen eye for a bargain.

charlie.name: Charlie the Tramp
charlie.examine: He knows the streets of Varrock better than anyone.

rovin.name: Captain Rovin
rovin.examine: Captain of the Varrock palace guard.

gertrude.name: Gertrude
gertrude.examine: She is looking for her cat.

ellis.name: Ellis the Tanner
ellis.examine: His hands are stained brown from tanning.

sabreen.name: Sister Sabreen
sabreen.examine: A healer of the Saradomin church.

boot.name: Boot the Dwarf
boot.examine: A dwarf with very muddy boots.

sarah.name: Farmer Sarah
sarah.examine: She farms the fields east of Falador.

wayne.name: Wayne the Armourer
wayne.examine: He makes the White Knights’ armour.

kaylee.name: Kaylee the Barmaid
kaylee.examine: She runs the Rising Sun inn.

elwyn.name: Elwyn the Bowyer
elwyn.examine: He makes the finest bows in Falador.

oswin.name: Oswin the Exile
oswin.examine: A knight who was cast out of Falador.

tomas.name: Tomas the Toymaker
tomas.examine: He makes toys for the village children.

iris.name: Iris the Seer
iris.examine: Her eyes seem to look straight through you.

bertram.name: Bertram
bertram.examine: A moneylender. Everyone owes him something.

fen.name: Fen the Fletcher
fen.examine: He makes arrows for the Ashford guard.

magda.name: Magda the Midwife
magda.examine: She has delivered half the babies in Ashford.

nim.name: Nim
nim.examine: A shadowy figure. Your pockets feel lighter already.

otto.name: Otto the Courier
otto.examine: He delivers letters all over the realm.

ada.name: Ada the Cartographer
ada.examine: She is mapping the whole realm.

shipwright.name: Shipwright Halvard
shipwright.examine: He builds ships for anyone with the coin and the nerve.

corvane.name: Huntmaster Corvane
corvane.examine: He hands out hunts and keeps the tally.

deedwarden.name: Deedwarden Oswin
deedwarden.examine: He sells Hearthstead deeds behind Brightwater.

maelis.name: Writkeeper Maelis
maelis.examine: She posts the daily writs and the weekly Hearthboard.

hesk.name: Warcaptain Hesk
hesk.examine: A scarred captain raising a warband.

brannoch.name: Factor Brannoch
brannoch.examine: The Charter Company factor in Wellmere.

ysmay.name: Elder Ysmay
ysmay.examine: She speaks for the Wellmere commons.

hale.name: Roostmaster Hale
hale.examine: He keeps the Skyrooks and their flight routes.

corvin.name: Delvemaster Corvin
corvin.examine: He sends parties into the Delves of Three.

mama_sorrel.name: Mama Sorrel
mama_sorrel.examine: A hex-witch who brews runes from bog and bone.

chronicler.name: Chronicler Corwin
chronicler.examine: He writes down the stories worth keeping.

deed_sign.name: Hearthstead plot sign
deed_sign.examine: "Hearthstead plots for sale. Ask Deedwarden Oswin."

chandler.name: Chandler Wenna
chandler.examine: She sells rope, tar and spades.

gullfisher.name: Old Gaffer Brune
gullfisher.examine: Saltgrave were a captain once, a cruel one. The sea took him and gave him back wrong.

dealer_crown.name: Dealer Quill
